theorem modular_power_of_coprime_seven (n : ℤ) (h : IsCoprime n 7) : n ^ 6 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by

    intro h_eq
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := h
    have hdvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ n := by
      refine ⟨n / 7, ?_⟩
      have h1 : n = n / 7 * 7 + n % 7 := by
        have := Int.ediv_add_emod n (7 : ℤ)
        linarith
      calc n = n / 7 * 7 + n % 7 := h1
        _ = n / 7 * 7 + 0 := by rw [h_eq]
        _ = 7 * (n / 7) := by ring
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
    have h7_dvd_one : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (1 : ℤ) := by
      refine ⟨a * k + b, ?_⟩
      calc (1 : ℤ) = a * n + b * 7 := by linarith
        _ = a * (7 * k) + b * 7 := by rw [hk]
        _ = 7 * (a * k + b) := by ring
    have h_not : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (1 : ℤ) := by
      intro ⟨c, hc⟩
      omega
    exact h_not h7_dvd_one
  have h_cong : (n % 7) ≡ n [ZMOD (7 : ℤ)] := by
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
    refine ⟨n / 7, ?_⟩
    have h1 : n = n / 7 * 7 + n % 7 := by
      have := Int.ediv_add_emod n (7 : ℤ)
      linarith
    calc n - n % 7 = n / 7 * 7 := by linarith
      _ = 7 * (n / 7) := by ring
  have h_symm : n ≡ (n % 7) [ZMOD (7 : ℤ)] := h_cong.symm
  have h_pow : n ^ 6 ≡ (n % 7) ^ 6 [ZMOD (7 : ℤ)] := h_symm.pow 6
  have h_pow_one : ((n % 7) ^ 6) ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD (7 : ℤ)] := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ n % 7 := Int.emod_nonneg n (by omega)
    have h1 : n % 7 < 7 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos n (by omega)
    have h_cases : n % 7 = 0 ∨ n % 7 = 1 ∨ n % 7 = 2 ∨ n % 7 = 3 ∨ n % 7 = 4 ∨ n % 7 = 5 ∨ n % 7 = 6 := by omega
    rcases h_cases with h_eq | h_eq | h_eq | h_eq | h_eq | h_eq | h_eq
    · exact absurd h_eq h_mod_ne
    · rw [h_eq]; decide
    · rw [h_eq]; decide
    · rw [h_eq]; decide
    · rw [h_eq]; decide
    · rw [h_eq]; decide
